label: Rectangle
visual_cues: Chest, waist and hips relatively similar.
outfit_ideas: Structured overshirts or jackets for added shape if desired | Straight or gently tapered trousers | Texture and colour-blocking for visual structure
fit_checks: Check shoulder seam placement | Choose size from garment chart, not shape

label: Inverted triangle
outfit_ideas: Simple shoulder lines and open collars | Straight or relaxed trousers to balance proportions if desired | V-necks or vertical details
fit_checks: Prioritize chest and shoulder fit | Buttons should not pull across chest

label: Triangle
outfit_ideas: Structured upper layers if desired | Simple bottoms with textured tops | Straight-leg trousers
fit_checks: Check hip and thigh room | Do not size down if the waistband or hips pull

label: Oval
visual_cues: Midsection fuller relative to shoulders and hips.
outfit_ideas: Softly structured layers and draping fabrics | Open overshirts or vertical seams if preferred | Mid-rise straight or relaxed trousers
fit_checks: Prioritize comfort when sitting and moving | Avoid body-shaming language

label: Trapezoid
visual_cues: Shoulders somewhat broader than waist; proportions fairly balanced.
outfit_ideas: Try slim, regular or relaxed cuts | Tees, shirts, denim and layers are versatile | Experiment with colours and accessories
fit_checks: Use chest/waist chart and personal preference

label: Athletic / muscular
visual_cues: More developed shoulders, chest, arms or thighs; proportions vary.
outfit_ideas: Athletic cuts or stretch panels for movement | Try tapered or relaxed cuts | Check upper-arm and thigh room
fit_checks: Do not size down to reduce looseness elsewhere | Consider tailoring if measurements span sizes

label: Rectangle
visual_cues: Bust, waist and hips relatively similar.
outfit_ideas: Layering, belted pieces or texture if you like waist definition | Straight trousers, A-line skirts, structured jackets | Choose prints and colours by preference
fit_checks: Fit bust/shoulders and hips first; tailoring can adjust waist

label: Hourglass
visual_cues: Bust and hips relatively balanced with a more defined waist.
outfit_ideas: Wrap tops or shaped jackets if you like waist definition | Stretch or contoured cuts | Straight, wide-leg and A-line bottoms can all work
fit_checks: Check both bust and hip measurements

label: Pear
outfit_ideas: Detailed or structured tops if desired | Straight, bootcut or wide-leg bottoms | A-line skirts and dresses
fit_checks: Prioritize hip/thigh room and a comfortable waistband

label: Apple / midsection-forward
visual_cues: Midsection fuller relative to bust/hips; bodies vary widely.
outfit_ideas: Relaxed drape or open layers if preferred | Straight-leg bottoms | Choose fabric for comfort, not concealment

label: Inverted triangle
visual_cues: Shoulders or bust broader than hips.
outfit_ideas: Simple shoulder lines with A-line or wide-leg bottoms if desired | V-necks or open collars | Use colour and print wherever you prefer
fit_checks: Check shoulder seams, bust ease and arm movement

label: Athletic / straight
visual_cues: May have straighter lines or more developed shoulders/legs.
outfit_ideas: Sporty layers, relaxed tailoring or wrap details | Stretch fabrics for movement | Fitted and loose silhouettes can both work
fit_checks: Ensure comfortable movement across shoulders, bust, hips and thighs
